name: Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card

tripDelay.notes: Up to $500 per covered trip for delays of 6+ hours. Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $10,000 per covered trip, $20,000 per eligible card account per 12 consecutive months.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person per trip.

emergencyMedical.notes: Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 emergency coordination including medical evacuation referrals and assistance. Actual costs are cardholder's responsibility (unlike the Platinum's Premium Global Assist which covers transport).

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage. Must decline rental company's CDW/LDW. Up to 30 consecutive days.

otherCredits.name: Free Night Award
otherCredits.notes: One Free Night Award annually after card anniversary. Redeemable at Marriott Bonvoy properties with redemption levels at or under 35,000 points.

otherCredits.name: Bonus Free Night Award
otherCredits.notes: Earn a second Free Night Award (up to 35,000 points) when you spend $60,000 on the card in a calendar year.

rewards.travelRate: 6x on purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy

otherBonusCategories.category: US wireless phone services from US providers

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.7–1.2¢ per Marriott Bonvoy point; best redeemed for hotel stays
